name: Croton Autoblogger AI
author: pabheto

sections.description:
Croton is a powerful WordPress plugin that automates the creation of SEO-optimized blog posts using advanced AI technology.
It operates as a SaaS (Software as a Service) plugin, using our engine at https://api.croton.es

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Content Generation: Leverage advanced AI to create SEO-optimized blog posts automatically
  • Free Plan: You can use the free plan to create your first posts by creating an account.
  • License-Based Authentication: Secure access with license key authentication per webpage
  • Easy Script Management: Create, view, and manage content generation scripts from the WordPress admin
  • SEO Optimization: Automatically generates content optimized for search engines
  • SEO Plugin Integration: Automatically fills meta keywords for Yoast SEO, RankMath, and All in One SEO
  • Post Architecture Suggestions: AI-generated post structure suggestions with reload capability
  • Media Library Integration: Automatically uploads AI-generated images to WordPress media library for better compatibility and management

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to the Croton settings page
  3. Enter your license key from https://app.croton.es
  4. Start creating SEO-optimized posts using the script creation interface

External Services

This plugin relies on the Croton API, a third-party external service, to generate AI-powered content for your WordPress site.

What is the service used for?
The Croton API (https://api.croton.es/) is used to:
– Generate SEO-optimized blog posts using advanced AI technology
– Create post architectures and content suggestions
– Generate AI images for your posts
– Validate and manage license keys for plugin activation

How the plugin interacts with the backoffice
Croton connects your WordPress admin with the Croton backoffice and API:
– You activate the plugin with your license key from https://app.croton.es
– You configure post generation options in WordPress
– The plugin sends post generation instructions to the API and receives generated content
– Generated content is returned to your WordPress site for draft creation and publishing workflows

What data is sent and when?
The plugin sends the following data to the API:
– License key (for activation and API authentication)
– Post generation communication data (for example keywords, language, topic, and generation settings)

Data is sent when:
– You activate your license key
– You request post generation or related content suggestions from the plugin

Service Terms and Privacy
– Terms of Use: https://croton.es/terms-of-service
– Privacy Policy: https://croton.es/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to transmit the necessary data to our API service for content generation purposes. All data transmission is done over secure HTTPS connections.

Terms of Use

By using Croton, you agree to the service terms that govern license validation and AI-powered post generation:
– Terms of Use: https://croton.es/terms-of-service
– Privacy Policy: https://croton.es/privacy-policy

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later, which means it is GPL-compatible and provides users with the four essential freedoms:

  • Freedom 0: The freedom to run the program for any purpose
  • Freedom 1: The freedom to study how the program works and change it to make it do what you wish (access to the source code is a precondition for this)
  • Freedom 2: The freedom to redistribute exact copies so you can help others
  • Freedom 3: The freedom to distribute copies of your modified versions to others, giving the whole community a chance to benefit from your changes (access to the source code is a precondition for this)

All included code is GPL-compatible and respects these freedoms as per WordPress Plugin Directory Guidelines.

For more information about the GPL license, visit: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.faq:
Do I need a license key?

Yes, a license key is required to authenticate with the backend API. You can obtain a free license key by registering at https://app.croton.es

What WordPress version do I need?

Croton requires WordPress 5.0 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher.

Is the plugin compatible with other SEO plugins?

Yes, Croton works alongside other SEO plugins and automatically integrates with them. When you create a draft, the plugin automatically fills in:
* Main keyword/Focus keyword for Yoast SEO, RankMath, and All in One SEO
* Meta title from your post title
* Meta description from your post excerpt

Supported SEO plugins:
* Yoast SEO
* RankMath
* All in One SEO

Can I reload the post architecture suggestions?

Yes! After viewing the AI-generated suggestions for your post structure, you can click the “Reload Suggestions” button to generate new suggestions if you’re not satisfied with the initial options.
